scope: Corollary 4.5 (Domination by free bridges) of the manuscript “Quantum Depletion for Fixed Bounded Repulsive Potentials” (preprints/Quantum-Depletion-for-Fixed-Bounded-Repulsive-Potentials-October-5-2026/fixed-repulsion-quantum-depletion.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 267 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 808cf0e274a8852c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Take finitely many labels at good sites, with product reference law Q i Bi, individual cutoffs, and any selection of the pair checks just considered. Normalize their indicator-weighted law. Its marginal on any q labels has density at most Cq relative to their product free-bridge law. The same conclusion holds conditionally on any individually allowed values of the other paths for which the conditional law is defined.
